mapper.sql: id, product_id, flash_price, limit_per_user, reserve_seconds, status, sort, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time, is_del, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM shop_flash_sale WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_del = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT t1.id, t2.id AS productId, t2.product_name AS productName, t2.image AS image, t2.price AS price, t1.flash_price AS flashPrice, t2.stock AS stock, t2.sales AS sales, t2.browse AS browse, t2.ficti_browse AS fictiBrowse, t1.limit_per_user AS limitPerUser, t1.status AS status, t1.start_time AS startTime, t1.end_time AS endTime FROM shop_flash_sale t1 LEFT JOIN shop_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id WHERE IFNULL(t1.is_del, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(t2.is_del, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(t2.is_show, 0) = 1 AND IFNULL(t2.is_seckill, 0) = 1 AND t2.activity = '1' AND t1.status = 1 AND t1.start_time <= #{now} AND t1.end_time >= #{now} ORDER BY t1.sort DESC, t2.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t1.id, t2.id AS productId, t2.product_name AS productName, t2.image AS image, t2.price AS price, t1.flash_price AS flashPrice, t2.stock AS stock, t2.sales AS sales, t2.browse AS browse, t2.ficti_browse AS fictiBrowse, t1.limit_per_user AS limitPerUser, t1.status AS status, t1.start_time AS startTime, t1.end_time AS endTime FROM shop_flash_sale t1 LEFT JOIN shop_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id WHERE IFNULL(t1.is_del, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(t2.is_del, 0) = 0 AND t1.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
